clips.title: The story
paras: In Starbreeze Village, the Emerald Dreamcatcher lies forgotten after the Gnarlpine furbolgs drove out its people. Druids of Ban’ethil Barrow Den gave it to Tallonkai Swiftroot, hoping it would draw vigor from the Emerald Dream.

Gaerolas Talvethren, the druidic warden of Ban’ethil Barrow Den, oversaw the making of the Emerald Dreamcatcher. The druids gave the enchanted amulet to only a chosen few. It draws ambient energy from the Emerald Dream, bringing fortune and protection to whoever carries it. When the maddened Gnarlpine furbolgs overran Starbreeze Village, the amulet remained inside a dresser, stranded in hostile, corrupted territory.
